column7: GET /api/v1/secrets returned the PAT owner's owned/shared/ACL-granted secrets (names, metadata) in every project to a PAT confined to another environment or holding only users.read, and to a project-confined PAT that asked ?project_id=<another project>: core.ListSecretsWithSharingInfo (the personal set, tier 3 of ListReadableSecrets and the unauthorized-scope branch of the handler) never consulted the PAT restriction. Fixed by filtering each source by patRestrictionFromContext.Allows(secrets.read, secret scope), the AuthorizeSecret check. Red before the fix with session and unrestricted-PAT controls green. Found by PAT-GUARD-1's family sweep
